properties.notes: Mixed use development on 7.4 hectares of land comprising up to 115 dwellings. Change of use of the Gatehouse to commercial use (Use Class B1); change of use of existing 'canteen' building to commercial and community uses (Use Classes B1/D1); engineering works to raise the raise the existing ground levels; associated landscaping and the retention of Ash House and Heather House in residential use (Use Class C3). 53 units completed at 18/19 Residential Land Survey.
